claim_text: The December 16, 2025 indictment in United States v. Hussein et al., No. 0:25-cr-00479 (ECF 1), alleges that between approximately January 2022 and April 2025 Pristine Health LLC submitted approximately $750,000 in fraudulent Medicaid claims related to Housing Stabilization Services, and that the defendants claimed to be entitled to about $750,000 for purported services to nearly 100 beneficiaries. That is an amount_claimed charging allegation, not amount_paid and not proven_loss. Paragraph 13 and paragraph 21 describe the same Pristine figure and must not be summed. Do not add this $750,000 to first-wave HSS (Aden/Falade/Anwar/Asad) or to Feeding Our Future.

supporting_passages.quote: In all, between approximately January 2022 and April 2025, Pristine Health submitted approximately $750,000 in fraudulent Medicaid claims related to the Housing Stabilization Services program.
Ultimately, the defendants claimed to service nearly 100 different beneficiaries through Pristine and for such services claimed to be entitled to about $750,000.

amounts.methodology: Indictment para 13: submitted approximately $750,000 in fraudulent Medicaid claims. Face of charging document; not amount_paid. Same figure restated as claimed-entitled in para 21.
